text: I found it: the chat flow in flows.ts doesn't pass the lookupOrder tool to ai.generate, unlike the order desk flow which does have tools configured. That explains why the assistant can't retrieve order or refund details through chat even though the order desk works correctly on its own.

The `chat` flow has no tools, but the reported symptom (every order and refund fails while the order desk works alone) points at the `triage` agent's delegation setup. I'll check what `maxDelegations: 0` means in the middleware before deciding.

text:
Found it: maxDelegations is set to 0, which blocks every delegation with a limit-reached message, so triage never gets the info it needs. The fix is to just remove that line entirely rather than setting some positive number, since omitting it defaults to unbounded.

The report's phrasing about the order desk still answering correctly on its own points to triage being the actual bug, since the chat flow isn't wired into the agent system at all and that's a separate design question I won't touch. The refund path through refundAgent still looks fine with its store and approval interrupt intact. And I've confirmed that maxDelegations: 0 behaves as always-true on the first call, so that's the root cause — I don't see other bugs like toolChoice settings causing issues.

I don't think I need to run the project since I lack API access anyway; the code itself is sufficient evidence of the bug, including how the delegation tool returns early with the limit message. Since this isn't a git repo, no commit is needed — I'll just edit agents.ts to fix the delegation limit check, then write the answer to answer.json at the project root.

The middleware confirms it: with `maxDelegations: 0`, every `delegate_to_*` call returns "Delegation limit reached (0)" before the sub-agent runs, so `triage` never gets an answer from `orderAgent` or `refundAgent`. I'll remove that option, which leaves delegation unbounded, and `maxTurns: 5` still caps the loop.
Since this is a new file, I didn't need to read it first. Let me quickly validate the JSON output with node to confirm the edit is correct.
Both edits are in. I'll confirm `answer.json` parses and the source change is the only one in `src/`.

text:
The root cause is in `src/agents.ts`: the `triage` agent's delegation middleware had `maxDelegations: 0`, so every hand-off to `orderAgent` or `refundAgent` was refused with "Delegation limit reached (0)" before the sub-agent ran. I removed that option, so delegation is no longer capped. `maxTurns: 5` still bounds the triage loop. The project type-checks, and `answer.json` is written at the project root.

I did not run the app against the live model, so the fix is confirmed by reading the middleware code, not by an end-to-end chat.

The `chat` flow in `src/flows.ts` is a separate path that doesn't go through `triage` and has no tools at all. I left it alone; if the support chat is meant to look up orders directly, it will need `tools: [lookupOrder]` or to route through `triage`.
